question: Where are an attraction positioned within 170 kilometers relative to Shechem Ministries, Lawrenceburg, KY in the west direction?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism ILIKE '%attraction%' AND ST_DWithin( geometry :: geography, ( SELECT geometry :: geography FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Shechem Ministries%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Lawrenceburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%KY%' LIMIT 1 ), 170000 ) AND ST_X(ST_Centroid(geometry)) < ST_X( ST_Centroid( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Shechem Ministries%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Lawrenceburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%KY%' LIMIT 1 ) ) );
